document.title: Traditional Knowledge Digital Library (TKDL) Institutional Framework

sections.section_title: TKDL Defensive Protection Mechanism & Access Policy
sections.content: The Traditional Knowledge Digital Library (TKDL) is a digital repository of traditional knowledge documented from classical Indian systems of medicine (Ayurveda, Siddha, Unani, Sowa Rigpa). TKDL acts as a defensive prior art database to prevent bio-piracy and wrongful patent grants at international patent offices. Public access is limited to institutional overview and access policy documents; full internal formulation data access is restricted under non-disclosure agreements with recognized International Patent Offices (IPOs).
